scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others -n API,WEB -c blue,magenta "dotnet run --project src/FinanceControl.Api" "npm run dev --workspace @lmm/finance-control-web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @lmm/finance-control-web && dotnet build FinanceControl.sln --configuration Release
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @lmm/finance-control-web && dotnet test FinanceControl.sln --configuration Release
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
